learning_outcomes.text: Students have advanced basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of Computer Science.
Students know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of Computer Science.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution.
Students have acquired competences preferably from the field of Artificial Intelligence.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercises tasks (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise tasks

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a point scale from 0 to 15 according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To receive credit, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise tasks and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise tasks. The examination can be either a written exam or an individual oral examination.
